Message.MsgText: The required WSDL file location was not provided.

Explanation.p: The Axis2 Web Service Client Function Component requires a WSDL file in order to generate all the required elements for the request message.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide a valid path to the WSDL file. It can point to a local file or remote URL.

Message.MsgText: No service specified in the Function Component's configuration.

Explanation.p: The Axis2 Web Service Client Function Component requires a service name which corresponds to the service which will be invoked.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide a valid service name. Use the button next to it to see all services in the WSDL file.

Message.MsgText: No endpoint specified in the Function Component's configuration.

Explanation.p: The Axis2 Web Service Client Function Component requires an endpoint name which corresponds to the Web Service's listening URL.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide a valid endpoint name. Use the button next to it to see all endpoints in the WSDL file.

Message.MsgText: No operation specified in the Function Component's configuration.

Explanation.p: The Axis2 Web Service Client Function Component requires an operation name which corresponds to the operation which will be invoked.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide a valid operation name. Use the button next to it to see all operations in the WSDL file.
